data.title: Liberty House
data.about:
Strategically located in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), Liberty House Dubai is a mixed-use building featuring 42 stories with eight floors dedicated to commercial spaces. The stories above the office floors are used for residential purposes in the building. You can find excellent units for sale and rent in the L-shaped tower. Handed over in 2009 by ETA Star property developers, the Liberty House DIFC address features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments and duplexes.

When it comes to Liberty House parking, every Liberty House DIFC office and apartment has been allocated a designated parking lot. The basement levels and six floors above ground are all dedicated to parking in the Liberty House building. Also, the topmost floor has a leisure deck and a sitting area. It is a pet-friendly tower with a spacious play area for kids, swimming pools, and a well-equipped gym.

characteristics_module.title: Boasting a Central Location and Exceptional Lifestyle Facilities
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Availability of spacious studio to 2-bedroom apartments and duplexes  
  • Offering views of Sheikh Zayed Road and the community
  • Easily accessible via public transportation and the road network.
  • The central location, amidst an array of tourist attractions
  • Enjoy proximity to the best dining places and retail spaces
  • Nearby supermarkets include Carrefour Market, Al Maya Supermarket, and Spinneys
  • An extensive swimming pool on the upper floor
  • A perfect option for those with a furry friend seeking a pet-friendly accommodation

location_tile.title: Discover Convenience at Liberty House in DIFC
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Proximity to various restaurants, supermarkets, bus stops, and metro stations makes Liberty House DIFC the best choice for families looking for a residence stocked with exceptional leisure and lifestyle amenities. Also, attractions like Dubai Mall and The Green Planet are 15 minutes from the exquisite Liberty House building.

Easily accessible via Sheikh Zayed Road, Liberty House enjoys an ideal location, boasting serene views of the highway and nearby areas. It is part of the iconic DIFC community, the hub for financial activities in South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. In addition to offering thriving business opportunities, the neighborhood provides residents with a vibrant lifestyle and several high-rise residential buildings.
